lua: CAM = require('lib.camera'); T = require('lib.testkit'); W = require('lib.world'); PARK = function(x, z, h) local v = nova.named('van'); v.autopilot = nil; v.driven = false; v.engine_on = false; v:teleport(x, z, h); nova.scene_now().mode = 'foot'; local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.seated = false; p.control = true end; AT = function(x, z, face) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z, p.face = x, z, face; p.walk_to, p.walk_path = nil, nil; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(face) end; WALK = function(dx, dz, pace) local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.walk_pace = pace or 2.3; p.walk_to = { p.x + dx, p.z + dz } end

route.lua: local d = nova.named('office_door'); local o = nova.scene_now().OUT_OF_DOOR or 4; AT(d.x + math.sin(d.ry) * o, d.z + math.cos(d.ry) * o, d.ry)

PARK(300, 300, 0); local h = nova.named('hazel'); local a = h.face or 0; AT(h.x + math.sin(a) * 2.0, h.z + math.cos(a) * 2.0, a + math.pi)
